market.summary: Large caps fell: Nifty 50 closed 25,607.20 (-1.07%) and Sensex 83,339.26 (-1.17%), led by IT and some banks, while midcaps (+0.10%) and smallcaps (+0.56%) held up. Crude was the main worry (Brent above $96 early after an attack on a Saudi refinery, about $92 by the close). For your holdings the damage was small: GROWW, THELEELA and DCI closed up; LALPATHLAB fell 2.7% and INDHOTEL stayed under its 10 EMA.

points.text: Nifty IT the weakest sector at -1.88% (TCS, Infosys, HCL Tech among the top losers); Nifty Metal the best at +1.40%.
Nifty Midcap 100 +0.10% and Smallcap 100 +0.56%: the fall was in heavyweights, not broad selling.
Brent above $96 early after an attack on a Saudi refinery, February futures about $92.3 at 3:35 pm; US markets were shut on Thursday for Thanksgiving and close early today.

market.watch: Crude and Monday's open after US Black Friday trade; a Nifty close back above 25,800 would ease the risk-off tone. FII figures could not be checked tonight.

GROWW.summary: No new company news found tonight. GROWW rose 1.1% to 222.41 on a day the Nifty fell 1.1%, closing above both the 10 EMA (220.12) and the 20 EMA (215.82). The rest of the position (after the 23 Nov partial sale) is about +1.8R with the stop at cost; it exits on a close below the 20 EMA.

points.text: Close 222.41 vs 220.01; range 220.28-225.19 on 2.0 crore shares, 54% delivery.
Held up against a Nifty fall of 1.07%: relative strength on a weak day.
BlackRock funds bought about 65 lakh shares in block deals at 219 on 17 Nov (older, still the latest deal on record).

GROWW.watch: A close below 215.82 (20 EMA) ends the trade; NSE filings were not refreshed today (engine issue, fixed tonight), so the morning read will re-check them.

THELEELA.summary: The Andaman management contracts (26 Nov) kept the stock in focus; it closed 690.00 (+0.6%) on a falling market after the low of 682.15 touched the 10 EMA (682.76) and recovered. The concall (14 Oct) was read tonight: strong first half, debt down, guidance kept, which supports the drift. The trade is about +2.7R with the stop at cost.

points.text: Close 690.00 vs 685.85; low 682.15 just under the 10 EMA 682.76, close back above it; 49% delivery.
Signed management contracts for two Andaman resorts (160 keys, opening 2029-30): fee income with no capital, a long-dated positive.
Listed among the morning's stocks in focus.
Concall: Q2 revenue +33%, EBITDA +36% (46% margin), net debt / EBITDA down to 1.4x; H2 EBITDA growth guided mid-to-high teens.

THELEELA.watch: Half goes on a close below the 10 EMA (682.76), which today's low already tested; the rest below the 20 EMA (668.65).
